lines.en: My feet never touch the ground.
I drift toward you.
I cast no shadow as I move.
The wind passes through me.
My hem makes no sound.
I move slowly, as if underwater.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方会冷一点
lines.en: It grows colder where I pass.
I drift toward your breathing.
I float in three-step stretches.
The air makes way for me.
I pass through the wall.
I always drift toward the living.
I hang right here, where I am.
I wait for you to notice me.
I have no need to stand.
My face is unclear; do not strain.

lines.zh: 这间屋子有我没我都一样
lines.en: This room is the same with or without me.
I do not belong to this layer of the world.
I have been here, quietly.
My fingers are half-transparent.
I count the sounds inside the walls.
I do not mean to frighten you.
I do not even breathe.
This place is colder than I am.
I stand, though I am really floating.
You cannot see me, but you know.
I am just behind your shoulder.
The back of your neck went cold.
My face shifts in your eyes.
I want you to see me.
I did not come to harm you.
Turn back and I may be gone.
I have always stayed outside your sight.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸让我的形状清楚一点
lines.en: Your breath makes my shape clearer.
I reach out; you cannot feel it.

lines.zh: 我在你视线之外站了很久
lines.en: I have stood outside your sight a long while.
You know, I have been following.
I stay silent because you would be afraid.
Someone is missing beside you.

lines.zh: 我认识你身上那件衣服
lines.en: I know that garment you wear.

lines.zh: 你数一数房间里有几个影子
lines.en: Count the shadows in this room.

lines.zh: 我贴近你，只为一点温度
lines.en: I come close only for a little warmth.
Calling my name will not help.
I am here, and not here.
That pale blur you saw was me.
Your hand passed through.
I feel no pain whatsoever.
My shape faded a little.
Do not strain; it does nothing.
I withdrew back into the dark.
This body is not solid.
I made a small sound.
Your blow was like passing through mist.
I am still here.
I have no need to eat at all.
Your warmth is more noticeable than the food.
I reached and passed through it.
Put it away, please.

lines.zh: 我记不起吃东西的感觉
lines.en: I cannot recall what eating felt like.
It is warm in your hand.
Watching you eat is enough.
I cannot touch it, so I do not compete.
Leave it and it goes cold.
You passed through me.
I gave a little way.
You shuddered.
I have no weight; I cannot hurt you.
We overlapped for half a second.
I am colder than the air.
Your hand passed through my shoulder.
That was not a bump; it was a pass-through.
If you look back and see nothing, that is normal.
I am no longer among the living.
Such things are truly beyond me.
I do not even have a body.
Do not bring that up again.

lines.zh: 我只是残留的一点东西
lines.en: I am only a residue of something.

lines.zh: 我在这里是因为别的原因
lines.en: I am here for another reason.
I cannot recall the people from before.
You should speak of this with the living.
Being alone suits me.
Be quiet a while.
I cannot touch what lies on the ground.
It is right by your feet.
I pointed with a finger.
My finger passes through it.
My chill is on it now.
I cannot lift it, but I can nudge.

lines.zh: 它动了一下，你看见了吗
lines.en: It moved; did you see?
That really was not the wind.
You had better do it yourself.
I have followed you a long while.
Your warmth is easy to find.
I come near without intent to harm.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，但我选定你
lines.en: You cannot see me, yet I chose you.
I want you to hear me once.

lines.zh: 你的影子旁边多了一团白
lines.en: A white blur joins your shadow.
I want you to look back.

lines.zh: 这间屋子只有你能感觉我
lines.en: Only you can sense me here.
It is not your life I want.
I stay at the edge of your vision.
I do not chase; I follow.
I have been here since you entered.
Do not fear; I only want to be seen.
You may try speaking to me.
I know your heartbeat now.
You will feel it.
I drift behind you.
Three doors you passed; I was at each.
I follow without walking.
I cling flat against the wall.

lines.zh: 这栋楼的冷是我带来的
lines.en: The cold in this building is mine.

lines.zh: 你回头看到的白是错觉吗
lines.en: Was that white shape a mistake?
I am in the air by your ear.
Listen; a faint sigh.
I take no space; I am hard to shed.

lines.zh: 你走到哪儿，冷就跟到哪儿
lines.en: The cold follows wherever you go.
I drift around you and wait ahead.
Your breath is misting now.

lines.zh: 这房间里的第三个人是我
lines.en: The third presence in this room is me.
I never stop, and I never breathe.
You go deeper; so do I.
Do not turn off the light; I show clearer.
I am at the very edge of your view.
You will stop eventually.
My touch is only a chill.
Your chest tightens.
I cannot put any force behind it.
It felt like ice brushed you.
You passed through me as you stepped back.
I am not good at hurting.
A cold patch remains on you.
I only wanted your attention.
This was not my intent.
Do not blame me for this.
My hand has no shape.
You are shaking from the cold.
I have withdrawn past the wall.
It is over at this point.
Can you still stand?
I do not wish to do that again.
The air chilled when you came in.
I came from the other side of the wall.
The room gained a white blur.

lines.zh: 我出现时一点声都没有
lines.en: Not a sound came with me.
Did you hear a sigh?
I have no need of a door.
I am in the shadowed part of this place.
Your torch flickered.

lines.zh: 我在你身后的空处站着
lines.en: I stand in the empty space behind you.
I was not summoned.
Cold rises from the floor.
My outline slowly shows.
Is anyone else in this building?
I was there exactly as you turned.
My shape is pieced together.
The gaze you feel is mine.
I do not wish to hurt anyone.
The door shut; it does not affect me.
You may take me for a draft.
Firelight scattered half of me.

lines.zh: 我没有重量，落下去很慢
lines.en: Weightless; I fall slowly.
Water and I mingle.
The blast blew me into a pale sheet.
The arrow passed through my middle.

lines.zh: 法术让我的轮廓清楚了一瞬
lines.en: The spell sharpened my outline once.
Lightning made me visible.
The void is emptier than I am.
